<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>HELL & HEAVEN | The Invitation</title>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;600;800;900&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-dark: #050508;
            --color-black: #08080a;
            --color-red: #8B0000;
            --color-red-glow: #ff1e27;
            --color-white: #f5f5f7;
            --color-silver: #c0c0c0;
            --color-purple: #3a1c4d;
            --color-gold: #dfa048;
            --glass-bg: rgba(18, 18, 24, 0.65);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            --font-heading: 'Cinzel', serif, Georgia;
            --font-body: 'Montserrat', sans-serif, Arial;
            --transition-smooth: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --theme-accent: #ffffff;
            --theme-glow: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }

        html, body {
            width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
            background-color: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--color-white);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        /* Ambient theme backdrop (fire for hell, light for heaven) */
        #theme-backdrop {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(58,28,77,0.35), transparent 60%);
            transition: background 1.2s ease;
        }
        body.theme-hell #theme-backdrop {
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(255,90,20,0.35), transparent 45%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 15%, rgba(139,0,0,0.4), transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(255,30,39,0.35), transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-dark);
            animation: emberPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        body.theme-heaven #theme-backdrop {
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,0.5), transparent 45%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(223,160,72,0.25), transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%, rgba(192,192,255,0.2), transparent 55%),
                #0d0d12;
            animation: haloPulse 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes emberPulse { 0% { filter: brightness(0.9); } 100% { filter: brightness(1.15); } }
        @keyframes haloPulse { 0% { filter: brightness(0.95); } 100% { filter: brightness(1.1); } }

        /* Floating theme motifs */
        #motif-layer { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 1s ease; }
        body.theme-hell #motif-layer, body.theme-heaven #motif-layer { opacity: 1; }
        .motif { position: absolute; font-size: 1.4rem; opacity: 0.35; animation: drift linear infinite; }
        @keyframes drift {
            0% { transform: translateY(110vh) rotate(0deg); }
            100% { transform: translateY(-10vh) rotate(30deg); }
        }

        #cursor-glow {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 500px; height: 500px;
            margin-left: -250px; margin-top: -250px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139,0,0,0.15) 0%, rgba(58,28,77,0.1) 40%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; transition: transform 0.1s ease-out; mix-blend-mode: screen;
        }
        body.theme-heaven #cursor-glow { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0%, rgba(223,160,72,0.12) 40%, transparent 70%); }
        body.theme-hell #cursor-glow { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,60,20,0.28) 0%, rgba(139,0,0,0.15) 40%, transparent 70%); }

        #particle-canvas { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 2; }

        #app-container {
            position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 3;
            overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        section {
            min-height: 100vh; width: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 2rem 1rem;
            position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0;
            opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.98);
            transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        section.active { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); pointer-events: auto; position: relative; }

        h1, h2, h3, .title-font { font-family: var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

        .subtitle { font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--color-silver); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; opacity: 0.85; text-align: center; }
        .quote-line { font-style: italic; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
        .mn-text { font-family: var(--font-body); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: center; }

        .btn-cinematic {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: var(--color-white);
            font-family: var(--font-heading); padding: 1rem 2.5rem; font-size: 1.05rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition-smooth); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            margin-top: 2rem; border-radius: 4px;
        }
        .btn-cinematic::before {
            content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.25), transparent); transition: 0.5s;
        }
        .btn-cinematic:hover::before { left: 100%; }
        .btn-cinematic:hover {
            border-color: var(--theme-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 25px var(--theme-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        }

        .glass-card {
            background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 2rem;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.65); width: 100%; max-width: 650px; position: relative;
        }

        #top-nav { position: fixed; top: 16px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; pointer-events: none; }
        #top-nav > * { pointer-events: auto; }
        .brand-mark { font-family: var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-silver); opacity: 0.85; }
        .nav-btn { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: var(--color-white);
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 1.5px; cursor: pointer;
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px); transition: var(--transition-smooth); }
        .nav-btn:hover { border-color: var(--theme-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--theme-glow); }

        #sound-toggle {
            position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 100;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: var(--color-white);
            width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
            cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2rem; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); transition: var(--transition-smooth);
        }
        #sound-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--color-white); transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

        #loader {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--bg-dark); z-index: 1000;
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; transition: opacity 1s ease;
        }
        .spinner { width: 50px; height: 50px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--color-white); border-bottom-color: var(--color-red); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 1.5s linear infinite; }
        @keyframes spin { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

        /* Intro */
        #sec-intro { text-align: center; }
        .intro-title { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3.2rem); line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: var(--color-white); }
        .intro-sub { font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem); color: var(--color-red-glow); letter-spacing: 5px; margin-bottom: 2rem; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,30,39,0.5); }

        /* Quiz */
        #sec-quiz .glass-card { max-width: 700px; }
        .quiz-progress-bar { width: 100%; height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 2px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; overflow: hidden; }
        .quiz-progress-fill { height: 100%; width: 10%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-red) 0%, var(--color-white) 100%); transition: width 0.4s ease; }
        .quiz-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--color-silver); }
        .question-text { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; min-height: 60px; line-height: 1.5; }
        .options-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.8rem; }
        .option-btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; color: var(--color-white); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition-smooth); display: flex; align-items: center; }
        .option-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); transform: translateX(5px); }
        .quiz-nav { margin-top: 1.5rem; display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; }
        .btn-back { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--color-silver); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; letter-spacing: 1px; opacity: 0.6; transition: 0.3s; }
        .btn-back:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--color-white); }

        #sec-judgement { text-align: center; }
        .judgement-pulse { font-size: 2rem; letter-spacing: 6px; animation: pulse-text 1.5s infinite alternate; }
        @keyframes pulse-text { 0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.98); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.02); text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } }

        #sec-result { text-align: center; }
        .result-icon { font-size: 4rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; display: inline-block; animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
        @keyframes float { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }
        .result-title { font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        .result-subtitle { color: var(--color-gold); font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
        .result-desc { font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); margin-bottom: 2rem; line-height: 1.7; }

        #sec-destination { text-align: center; width: 100%; }
        .dest-grid { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 3rem; margin-top: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .dest-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; width: 240px; position: relative; }
        .dest-img-wrap { width: 180px; height: 180px; position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; transition: var(--transition-smooth); }
        .dest-emoji { font-size: 6rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)); transition: var(--transition-smooth); animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .dest-card.heaven:hover .dest-emoji { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(255,255,255,0.9)); transform: scale(1.1); }
        .dest-card.hell:hover .dest-emoji { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(255,30,39,0.9)); transform: scale(1.1); }
        .dest-label { margin-top: 1.2rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem; background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-white); backdrop-filter: blur(5px); transition: var(--transition-smooth); }
        .dest-card:hover .dest-label { border-color: var(--color-white); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

        /* Event TAX section */
        #sec-event { text-align: center; }
        .event-heading { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4.5vw, 2.8rem); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
        .event-tagline { font-style: italic; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
        .TAX-card {
            width: 100%; max-width: 620px; background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 2.2rem 2rem; box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--theme-glow), 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
            position: relative;
        }
        .TAX-eyebrow { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 3px; color: var(--theme-accent); margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
        .TAX-title { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.3rem); letter-spacing: 4px; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
        .TAX-sub { font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--color-silver); margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
        .TAX-divider { height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.25), transparent); margin: 0 0 1.4rem 0; }
        .event-details-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; text-align: left; }
        .event-detail-item { padding: 0.9rem 1rem; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; }
        .event-detail-item .detail-icon { font-size: 1.4rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .event-detail-item .label { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--color-silver); letter-spacing: 1px; margin-bottom: 0.15rem; }
        .event-detail-item .value { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 0.98rem; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
        .location-link { color: var(--color-gold); text-decoration: none; transition: 0.3s; }
        .location-link:hover { color: var(--color-white); text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--color-gold); }

        .countdown-title { font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 3px; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-silver); }
        .countdown-grid { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 1.6rem; }
        .time-card { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); padding: 0.7rem; border-radius: 8px; min-width: 62px; }
        .time-number { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: bold; display: block; }
        .time-label { font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--color-silver); }

        /* ===== HELL vs HEAVEN — drastically different invitation vibe ===== */

        /* HELL: jagged, cracked, aggressive, flickering flame */
        body.theme-hell .event-heading {
            color: var(--color-red-glow);
            font-weight: 900;
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            animation: hellTextPulse 2.2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes hellTextPulse {
            0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,30,39,0.6), 0 0 2px rgba(255,120,60,0.9); }
            45% { text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,30,39,1), 0 0 60px rgba(139,0,0,0.9); }
            50% { text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,30,39,0.3); }
            55% { text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,30,39,1), 0 0 60px rgba(139,0,0,0.9); }
        }
        body.theme-hell .event-tagline { color: rgba(255,150,120,0.85); }
        body.theme-hell .TAX-card {
            background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(25,4,4,0.9), rgba(50,2,2,0.75));
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,30,39,0.55);
            border-radius: 6px;
            clip-path: polygon(1.5% 0%, 98.5% 0%, 100% 2.5%, 100% 97.5%, 98.5% 100%, 1.5% 100%, 0% 97.5%, 0% 2.5%);
            box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(255,30,39,0.45), inset 0 0 40px rgba(139,0,0,0.35);
            animation: hellFlicker 5s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes hellFlicker {
            0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1); }
            48% { filter: brightness(1.1) contrast(1.05); }
            50% { filter: brightness(0.85) contrast(1.1); }
            52% { filter: brightness(1.1) contrast(1.05); }
        }
        body.theme-hell .TAX-eyebrow { color: var(--color-red-glow); }
        body.theme-hell .TAX-title {
            color: #fff2ee;
            text-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255,30,39,0.9), 0 0 35px rgba(139,0,0,0.7);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
        }
        body.theme-hell .TAX-sub { color: rgba(255,150,120,0.75); }
        body.theme-hell .TAX-divider { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,30,39,0.6), transparent); }
        body.theme-hell .event-detail-item {
            background: rgba(20,0,0,0.55);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,30,39,0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        body.theme-hell .event-detail-item .value { color: #ffdcd0; }
        body.theme-hell .quote-line { color: rgba(255,150,120,0.8); }
        body.theme-hell .countdown-title { color: rgba(255,150,120,0.75); }
        body.theme-hell .time-card {
            background: rgba(20,0,0,0.65);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,30,39,0.4);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        body.theme-hell .time-number { color: var(--color-red-glow); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,30,39,0.7); }
        body.theme-hell .btn-cinematic { border-color: rgba(255,30,39,0.5); border-radius: 4px; }
        body.theme-hell .btn-cinematic:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,30,39,0.6); border-color: var(--color-red-glow); }
        body.theme-hell .location-link { color: #ff8a5c; }
        body.theme-hell .location-link:hover { color: var(--color-red-glow); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,30,39,0.7); }

        /* HEAVEN: soft, serene, glowing, weightless */
        body.theme-heaven .event-heading {
            color: #ffffff;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            animation: heavenGlow 3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes heavenGlow {
            0% { text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
            100% { text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,1), 0 0 55px rgba(223,160,72,0.5); }
        }
        body.theme-heaven .event-tagline { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-style: italic; }
        body.theme-heaven .TAX-card {
            background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.09), rgba(223,160,72,0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
            border-radius: 28px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(255,255,255,0.35), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            animation: heavenBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes heavenBreathe {
            0% { box-shadow: 0 0 55px rgba(255,255,255,0.25), inset 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
            100% { box-shadow: 0 0 85px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), inset 0 0 45px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
        }
        body.theme-heaven .TAX-eyebrow { color: var(--color-gold); }
        body.theme-heaven .TAX-title {
            color: #ffffff;
            text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 0 40px rgba(223,160,72,0.4);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
        }
        body.theme-heaven .TAX-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
        body.theme-heaven .TAX-divider { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.4), transparent); }
        body.theme-heaven .event-detail-item {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
            border-radius: 16px;
        }
        body.theme-heaven .event-detail-item .value { color: #ffffff; }
        body.theme-heaven .quote-line { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
        body.theme-heaven .countdown-title { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }
        body.theme-heaven .time-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
            border-radius: 14px;
        }
        body.theme-heaven .time-number { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
        body.theme-heaven .btn-cinematic { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); border-radius: 24px; }
        body.theme-heaven .btn-cinematic:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
        body.theme-heaven .location-link { color: var(--color-gold); }
        body.theme-heaven .location-link:hover { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

        /* Payment */
        #sec-payment { text-align: center; }
        .qr-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; }
        .qr-wrapper { position: relative; width: 200px; height: 200px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition-smooth); background: #fff; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
        .qr-wrapper:hover { transform: scale(1.04); border-color: var(--color-white); box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
        .qr-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
        .qr-fallback { color: #111; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; }
        .price-tag { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--color-gold); letter-spacing: 2px; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

        #qr-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); z-index: 500; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; }
        #qr-modal.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
        .modal-qr-img { max-width: 80vw; max-height: 60vh; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-white); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
        .modal-close { margin-top: 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-white); color: var(--color-white); padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: 2px; }

        /* RSVP */
        #sec-rsvp { text-align: center; }
        .rsvp-choices { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .rsvp-btn { padding: 1.2rem 2rem; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); color: var(--color-white); font-family: var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition-smooth); min-width: 220px; }
        .rsvp-btn.yes:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transform: translateY(-3px); }
        .rsvp-btn.no:hover { border-color: var(--color-red-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,30,39,0.3); transform: translateY(-3px); }

        /* Outro */
        #sec-outro { text-align: center; }
        .outro-title { font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem); letter-spacing: 6px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
        body.theme-hell .outro-title { color: var(--color-red-glow); animation: hellTextPulse 2.2s infinite; }
        body.theme-heaven .outro-title { color: #ffffff; animation: heavenGlow 3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .dest-grid { gap: 1.5rem; }
            .dest-img-wrap { width: 130px; height: 130px; }
            .dest-emoji { font-size: 4.2rem; }
            .countdown-grid { gap: 0.5rem; }
            .time-card { min-width: 52px; padding: 0.5rem; }
            .time-number { font-size: 1.2rem; }
            .glass-card, .TAX-card { padding: 1.5rem 1rem; }
            .event-details-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            #top-nav { padding: 0 12px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div id="theme-backdrop"></div>
    <div id="motif-layer"></div>
    <div id="cursor-glow"></div>
    <canvas id="particle-canvas"></canvas>

    <div id="top-nav">
        <span class="brand-mark">HELL &amp; HEAVEN</span>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem;">
            <button class="nav-btn" id="theme-switch-btn" onclick="switchTheme()" style="display:none;">VIEW OTHER SIDE</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <button id="sound-toggle" aria-label="Toggle Sound">🔇</button>

    <audio id="bg-audio" loop preload="auto">
        <source src="assets/ambient.mp3" type="audio/mpeg">
    </audio>

    <div id="loader">
        <div class="spinner"></div>
        <p style="margin-top: 1rem; letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-family: var(--font-heading);">SUMMONING THE DESTINY...</p>
    </div>

    <div id="app-container">

        <section id="sec-intro" class="active">
            <p class="subtitle">EVERY SOUL HAS TWO SIDES</p>
            <h1 class="intro-title">YOU HAVE BEEN INVITED<br>TO THE OTHER SIDE</h1>
            <h2 class="intro-sub">HELL &amp; HEAVEN</h2>
            <p class="mn-text" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;">Шүүлтийг эхлүүлье</p>
            <button class="btn-cinematic" onclick="startExperience()">BEGIN</button>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-quiz">
            <div class="glass-card">
                <div class="quiz-progress-bar"><div class="quiz-progress-fill" id="quiz-progress"></div></div>
                <div class="quiz-header">
                    <span>😇 ANGEL vs 😈 DEVIL</span>
                    <span id="question-counter">QUESTION 1 / 10</span>
                </div>
                <p class="subtitle" style="text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Сонголтоо болгоомжтой хийгээрэй.</p>
                <p class="mn-text" style="text-align: left; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; opacity: 0.7;"> Хариулт нь таныг хаана харьяалагдахыг тодорхойлно.</p>
                <div class="question-text" id="question-text">Loading question...</div>
                <div class="options-grid" id="options-container"></div>
                <div class="quiz-nav"><button class="btn-back" id="btn-quiz-back" onclick="previousQuestion()" style="display: none;">← BACK</button></div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-judgement">
            <div class="judgement-pulse">YOUR ANSWERS HAVE BEEN JUDGED.</div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-result">
            <div class="glass-card">
                <div class="result-icon" id="res-icon">✨</div>
                <h2 class="result-title" id="res-title">YOUR RESULT</h2>
                <div class="result-subtitle" id="res-subtitle">SOUL TYPE</div>
                <p class="result-desc" id="res-desc">Description loading...</p>
                <p class="subtitle" style="margin-top: 1rem;">BUT KNOWING WHO YOU ARE IS ONLY HALF THE STORY.</p>
                <button class="btn-cinematic" onclick="goToDestinationChoice()">CONTINUE</button>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-destination">
            <h2 class="title-font" style="font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Та бол сонгогдсон нэгэн </h2>
            <p class="subtitle">Сонголт таны гарт</p>
            <div class="dest-grid">
                <button class="dest-card heaven" onclick="chooseDestination('heaven')" aria-label="Choose Heaven">
                    <div class="dest-img-wrap"><div class="dest-emoji">👼</div></div>
                    <div class="dest-label">HEAVEN</div>
                </button>
                <button class="dest-card hell" onclick="chooseDestination('hell')" aria-label="Choose Hell">
                    <div class="dest-img-wrap"><div class="dest-emoji">😈</div></div>
                    <div class="dest-label">HELL</div>
                </button>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-event">
            <h2 class="event-heading" id="event-welcome-text">WELCOME</h2>
            <p class="event-tagline" id="event-flavor-text">...</p>

            <div class="TAX-card">
                <div class="TAX-eyebrow">OFFICIAL EVENT TAX</div>
                <div class="TAX-title">HELL &amp; HEAVEN</div>
                <div class="TAX-sub">WELCOME NIGHT · ONE NIGHT, TWO SIDES</div>
                <div class="TAX-divider"></div>

                <div class="event-details-grid">
                    <div class="event-detail-item">
                        <span class="detail-icon">📅</span>
                        <div><div class="label">DATE</div><div class="value">2026.10.04</div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="event-detail-item">
                        <span class="detail-icon">⏰</span>
                        <div><div class="label">TIME</div><div class="value">16:00</div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="event-detail-item">
                        <span class="detail-icon">📍</span>
                        <div><div class="label">LOCATION</div><div class="value"><a href="https://www.google.com/maps/place/A%26G+Restaurant/@47.9230008,106.9396904,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x5d9693002ea009c1:0xf87e7cb5c0b5cfb8!8m2!3d47.9230008!4d106.9396904!16s%2Fg%2F11x5kkvyh6!18m1!1e1?entry=ttu" target="_blank" class="location-link">A&amp;G Restaurant ↗</a></div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="event-detail-item">
                        <span class="detail-icon" id="dress-code-icon">🎭</span>
                        <div><div class="label">DRESS CODE</div><div class="value" id="dress-code-value">...</div></div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <p class="quote-line">"COVERNIGHT эхлэх хугацаа ойртсоор... " </p>

                <div class="countdown-title">THE GATES WILL OPEN IN</div>
                <div class="countdown-grid" id="countdown-timer">
                    <div class="time-card"><span class="time-number" id="cd-days">00</span><span class="time-label">DAYS</span></div>
                    <div class="time-card"><span class="time-number" id="cd-hours">00</span><span class="time-label">HOURS</span></div>
                    <div class="time-card"><span class="time-number" id="cd-minutes">00</span><span class="time-label">MINUTES</span></div>
                    <div class="time-card"><span class="time-number" id="cd-seconds">00</span><span class="time-label">SECONDS</span></div>
                </div>

                <button class="btn-cinematic" onclick="goToSection('sec-rsvp')">ТА БИДЭНТЭЙ НЭГДЭХ ҮҮ</button>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-rsvp">
            <div class="glass-card">
                <h2 class="title-font" id="rsvp-heading">ТА БИДЭНТЭЙ НЭГДЭХ ҮҮ?</h2>
                <p class="subtitle" id="rsvp-sub"> </p>

                <div id="rsvp-options" class="rsvp-choices">
                    <button class="rsvp-btn yes" onclick="handleRsvp('yes')">ТИЙМ.</button>
                    <button class="rsvp-btn no" onclick="handleRsvp('no')">ҮГҮЙ</button>
                </div>

                <div id="rsvp-response" style="display: none; margin-top: 2rem;">
                    <h3 id="rsvp-resp-title" style="letter-spacing: 3px; font-size: 1.5rem;">Таны суудлыг амжилттай баталгаажууллаа.</h3>
                    <p id="rsvp-resp-desc" class="subtitle" style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">WE'LL SEE YOU ON THE OTHER SIDE.</p>
                    <div id="rsvp-change-wrap" style="display: none; margin-top: 1.5rem;">
                        <button class="btn-back" onclick="resetRsvp()">CHANGE MY MIND</button>
                    </div>
                    <button class="btn-cinematic" id="rsvp-next-btn" onclick="afterRsvp()" style="margin-top: 2rem;">CONTINUE</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-payment">
            <div class="glass-card">
                <h2 class="title-font">YOUR TAX AWAITS</h2>
                <p class="subtitle">QR-ыг уншуулж төлбөрөө хийнэ үү.</p>

                <div class="qr-card">
                    <div class="qr-wrapper" onclick="openQrModal()">
                        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Payment QR" class="qr-img" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">
                        <div class="qr-fallback" style="display:none;">QR CODE IMAGE NOT FOUND<br><br>Replace assets/qr.jpg with your QR image.</div>
                    </div>
                    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--color-silver);">ДАРЖ ТОМРУУЛАХ </span>
                </div>

                <div class="price-tag" id="display-TAX-price">TAX: --,---₮</div>

                <div style="margin: 1.5rem 0; font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);">
                    <p><strong>PAYMENT DETAILS &amp; ENTRY</strong></p>
                    <p>Төлбөрөө хийснээр таны урилга баталгаажна </p>
                </div>

                <button class="btn-cinematic" onclick="goToSection('sec-outro')">FINAL DESTINY</button>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section id="sec-outro">
            <h1 class="outro-title">SEE YOU ON THE OTHER SIDE.</h1>
            <p class="subtitle" style="letter-spacing: 5px; color: var(--color-white);">HELL • HEAVEN • ONE NIGHT</p>
            <p class="title-font" style="color: var(--color-gold); margin-top: 2rem; letter-spacing: 3px;">DEVIL &amp; ANGEL</p>
            <p style="letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--color-silver); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 0.5rem;">2026.10.04</p>
        </section>

    </div>

    <div id="qr-modal" onclick="closeQrModal()">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Scan to Pay QR" class="modal-qr-img" onerror="this.style.display='none';">
        <p style="color: white; margin-top: 1rem; letter-spacing: 2px; font-family: var(--font-heading);">SCAN TO PAY</p>
        <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeQrModal()">CLOSE (ESC)</button>
    </div>

    <script>
        const TAXPrice = " 70,000₮";

        const quizQuestions = [
            { q: "Хэн нэгэн чамд шударга бус хандвал…", options: [
                { text: "Тайван ярилцаж ойлголцоно", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Шууд хэлж асуудлыг шийднэ", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "Дуугүй өнгөрөөнө", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Харьцахаа болино", a: 0, d: 2 }
            ]},
            { q: "Чамд маш чухал боломж ирсэн боловч найз чинь өөрөө авахын тулд чамайг санаатайгаар муухай харагдуулжээ.", options: [
                { text: "Шууд буруутгахгүй, ойлгохыг хичээнэ", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Алдааг нь хэлээд засахад тусална", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "“Өөрөө мэд” гээд орхино", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Яагаад ийм алдаа гаргасныг нь асууна", a: 1, d: 0 }
            ]},
            { q: "Найз чинь чамд маш муухай зүйл хийсэн. Хэсэг хугацааны дараа түүнд яг адилхан зүйл хийх боломж чамд гарч ирэв. Гол нь чамаас өөр хэн ч мэдэх боломжгүй?", options: [
                { text: "Боломж байсан ч юу ч хийхгүй, өөрийнхөө зарчмыг баримтална", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Түүнтэй ярилцаад, яагаад тэгснийг нь ойлгохыг хичээнэ", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Яг адилхан зүйл хийж, ямар мэдрэмж төрдгийг нь ойлгуулна", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Шууд өшөө авахгүй ч түүнд дахиж туслахгүй", a: 0, d: 1 }
            ]},
            { q: "Маргааны үед чи…", options: [
                { text: "Эвлэрэх арга хайдаг", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Өөрийн байр сууриа хамгаалдаг", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Аль болох маргалдахгүй", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Нөгөө хүнийг дийлэхийг хүсдэг", a: 0, d: 2 }
            ]},
            { q: "Чамд хүссэн бүхнээ авах боломж олдоно. Гэхдээ нэг нөхцөлтэй: чи юу ч авсан, тэр зүйл яг тэр хэмжээгээрээ дэлхийн хаа нэгтээ байгаа өөр нэг хүнээс хасагдана. Чи энэ боломжийг ашиглах уу?", options: [
                { text: "Үгүй. Өөрийн хүсэл биелэхийн төлөө гэмгүй хүнийг хохироохыг хүсэхгүй", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Зөвхөн хэнд ч ноцтой хохирол учруулахгүй зүйл байвал ашиглаж магадгүй", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Тийм. Тэр хүнийг би мэдэхгүй, өөрийн боломжийг яагаад алдах ёстой гэж?", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "Боломж олдсон л бол ашиглах нь зөв", a: 0, d: 2 }
            ]},
            { q: "Хэн нэгэн чамайг доромжловол…", options: [
                { text: "Тоохгүй өнгөрөөнө", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Тайван боловч хатуу хариу өгнө", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "Шууд буцааж хэлнэ", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Тэр хүнтэй цаашид харилцахгүй", a: 0, d: 1 }
            ]},
            { q: "Найз чинь нэг асуудалд буруутгагдаад цагдаа дээр дуудагдав. Тэр чамаас “Намайг тэр үед хамт байсан гэж хэлээд өгөөч” гэж хүсэв. Үнэндээ чи түүнтэй хамт байгаагүй. Чи яах вэ?", options: [
                { text: "Иргэн хүний үүргийн дагуу үнэнийг хэлнэ", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Шууд худал хэлэхгүй ч найзыгаа хамгаалах өөр арга хайна", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Найзыгаа асуудлаас гаргахын тулд худал хэлнэ", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "Хэн ч мэдэхгүй бол худлаа хэлэхэд яавал гэж", a: 0, d: 2 }
            ]},
            { q: "Хэн нэгэн чамаас илүү амжилт гаргавал…", options: [
                { text: "Чин сэтгэлээсээ баярлана", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Өөрийгөө түүнтэй харьцуулна", a: 0, d: 1 },
                { text: "Би ч бас илүү сайн болохыг хүснэ", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Түүнээс суралцахыг хичээнэ", a: 1, d: 0 }
            ]},
            { q: "Хэн нэгэн чиний итгэлийг эвдвэл…", options: [
                { text: "Уучлахыг хичээнэ", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "Итгэлээ дахин олж авах боломж өгнө", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "Нэг л удаа алдсан бол дууссан", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "Өөрийгөө хамгаалахын тулд зай барина", a: 0, d: 1 }
            ]},
            { q: "Өөрийгөө аль нь гэж тодорхойлох  вэ?", options: [
                { text: "❤️ Энэрэнгүй", a: 2, d: 0 },
                { text: "🧠 Тайван, бодлоготой", a: 1, d: 0 },
                { text: "🔥 Дүрмэнд захирагдахгүй", a: 0, d: 2 },
                { text: "🖤 Нууцлаг", a: 0, d: 2 }
            ]}
        ];

        let currentQuestionIdx = 0;
        let userAnswers = [];
        let isAudioPlaying = false;
        let particleTheme = 'neutral';
        let chosenDestination = null;
        let rsvpChoice = null;
        let finalAngelScore = 0;
        let finalDevilScore = 0;

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            document.getElementById('display-TAX-price').innerText = `TAX${TAXPrice}`;
            initParticles();

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                document.getElementById('cursor-glow').style.transform = `translate(${e.clientX}px, ${e.clientY}px)`;
            });
            window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeQrModal(); });

            startCountdown();

            setTimeout(() => {
                const loader = document.getElementById('loader');
                loader.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => loader.style.display = 'none', 1000);
            }, 800);
        });

        function goToSection(sectionId) {
            document.querySelectorAll('section').forEach(sec => sec.classList.remove('active'));
            const target = document.getElementById(sectionId);
            if (target) {
                target.classList.add('active');
                document.getElementById('app-container').scrollTop = 0;
            }
        }

        function startExperience() {
            toggleAudio(true);
            currentQuestionIdx = 0;
            userAnswers = [];
            renderQuestion();
            goToSection('sec-quiz');
        }

        const bgAudio = document.getElementById('bg-audio');
        const soundToggleBtn = document.getElementById('sound-toggle');

        function toggleAudio(forcePlay = false) {
            if (forcePlay || !isAudioPlaying) {
                bgAudio.play().then(() => {
                    isAudioPlaying = true;
                    soundToggleBtn.innerText = '🔊';
                }).catch(() => {
                    isAudioPlaying = false;
                    soundToggleBtn.innerText = '🔇';
                });
            } else {
                bgAudio.pause();
                isAudioPlaying = false;
                soundToggleBtn.innerText = '🔇';
            }
        }
        soundToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleAudio());

        function shuffleArray(array) {
            const arr = [...array];
            for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
            }
            return arr;
        }

        function renderQuestion() {
            const qData = quizQuestions[currentQuestionIdx];
            const progressPct = ((currentQuestionIdx + 1) / quizQuestions.length) * 100;
            document.getElementById('quiz-progress').style.width = `${progressPct}%`;
            document.getElementById('question-counter').innerText = `QUESTION ${currentQuestionIdx + 1} / ${quizQuestions.length}`;
            document.getElementById('question-text').innerText = qData.q;

            const shuffledOptions = shuffleArray(qData.options);
            const optionsContainer = document.getElementById('options-container');
            optionsContainer.innerHTML = '';
            shuffledOptions.forEach((opt) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'option-btn';
                btn.innerText = opt.text;
                btn.onclick = () => selectOption(opt);
                optionsContainer.appendChild(btn);
            });

            document.getElementById('btn-quiz-back').style.display = currentQuestionIdx > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
        }

        function selectOption(option) {
            userAnswers[currentQuestionIdx] = option;
            if (currentQuestionIdx < quizQuestions.length - 1) {
                currentQuestionIdx++;
                renderQuestion();
            } else {
                processJudgement();
            }
        }

        function previousQuestion() {
            if (currentQuestionIdx > 0) {
                currentQuestionIdx--;
                renderQuestion();
            }
        }

        function processJudgement() {
            goToSection('sec-judgement');
            let angelScore = 0, devilScore = 0;
            userAnswers.forEach(ans => { angelScore += ans.a; devilScore += ans.d; });
            finalAngelScore = angelScore;
            finalDevilScore = devilScore;
            setTimeout(() => {
                displayResult(angelScore, devilScore);
                goToSection('sec-result');
            }, 2500);
        }

        function displayResult(angelScore, devilScore) {
            const iconEl = document.getElementById('res-icon');
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('res-title');
            const subEl = document.getElementById('res-subtitle');
            const descEl = document.getElementById('res-desc');

            if (angelScore > devilScore) {
                iconEl.innerText = '👼';
                titleEl.innerText = 'YOU ARE AN ANGEL.';
                subEl.innerText = angelScore >= 16 ? 'STRONG ANGEL' : 'Энэ бол таны дүр';
                descEl.innerText = 'Таны сонголтуудаас харахад та бусдыг ойлгох сэтгэл, үнэнч байдал, эргэн тойрныхоо хүмүүсийг хамгаалахыг эрхэмлэдэг нэгэн байна. Гэхдээ сахиусан тэнгэрт хүртэл харанхуй тал байдаг.';
            } else if (devilScore > angelScore) {
                iconEl.innerText = '😈';
                titleEl.innerText = 'YOU ARE A DEVIL.';
                subEl.innerText = devilScore >= 17 ? 'STRONG DEVIL' : 'Энэ бол таны дүр';
                descEl.innerText = 'Та  бусдын тогтоосон дүрмээс илүү өөрийнхөөрөө амьдрахыг илүүд үздэг. Гэхдээ чөтгөрүүдэд хүртэл  хайрлаж явах үнэ цэнтэй зүйл бий..';
            } else {
                iconEl.innerText = '☯️';
                titleEl.innerText = 'YOUR SOUL IS DIVIDED.';
                subEl.innerText = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'ANGEL WITH A DARK SIDE' : 'DEVIL WITH A SOFT HEART';
                descEl.innerText = "Та бол сонгогдсон нэгэн. Сонголт таны гарт";
            }
        }

        function goToDestinationChoice() {
            // The choice screen only appears when the soul is tied (angel === devil).
            // Otherwise destiny is already decided by the quiz result — no choice given.
            if (finalAngelScore === finalDevilScore) {
                goToSection('sec-destination');
            } else {
                const decidedDestination = finalAngelScore > finalDevilScore ? 'heaven' : 'hell';
                chooseDestination(decidedDestination, false);
            }
        }

        function buildMotifs(theme) {
            const layer = document.getElementById('motif-layer');
            layer.innerHTML = '';
            const glyph = theme === 'hell' ? '🔥' : '🪶';
            const count = 14;
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const span = document.createElement('span');
                span.className = 'motif';
                span.innerText = glyph;
                span.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}%`;
                span.style.fontSize = `${1 + Math.random() * 1.6}rem`;
                span.style.animationDuration = `${10 + Math.random() * 14}s`;
                span.style.animationDelay = `-${Math.random() * 14}s`;
                layer.appendChild(span);
            }
        }

        function applyTheme(dest) {
            const welcomeText = document.getElementById('event-welcome-text');
            const flavorText = document.getElementById('event-flavor-text');
            const dressIcon = document.getElementById('dress-code-icon');
            const dressValue = document.getElementById('dress-code-value');
            const root = document.documentElement.style;

            if (dest === 'heaven') {
                document.body.className = 'theme-heaven';
                particleTheme = 'heaven';
                root.setProperty('--theme-accent', '#ffffff');
                root.setProperty('--theme-glow', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)');
                welcomeText.innerText = 'WELCOME TO HEAVEN.';
                flavorText.innerText = '"Perhaps you were always meant to be here."';
                dressIcon.innerText = '👑';
                dressValue.innerText = 'Pure White, Silver & Pastel (Цагаан, мөнгөлөг эсвэл цайвар пастел өнгөнүүд)';
            } else {
                document.body.className = 'theme-hell';
                particleTheme = 'hell';
                root.setProperty('--theme-accent', '#ff5a28');
                root.setProperty('--theme-glow', 'rgba(255,60,20,0.35)');
                welcomeText.innerText = 'WELCOME TO THE HELL.';
                flavorText.innerText = '"You were always destined for this."';
                dressIcon.innerText = '🎭';
                dressValue.innerText = 'Dark Black & ❤️ Blood Red (Хар  өнгө давамгайлсан) ';
            }
            buildMotifs(dest);
        }

        function chooseDestination(dest, wasChosenByUser = true) {
            chosenDestination = dest;
            applyTheme(dest);
            const switchBtn = document.getElementById('theme-switch-btn');
            if (wasChosenByUser) {
                // Only offer a peek at the other side when it was genuinely a choice (tied souls).
                switchBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
                switchBtn.innerText = dest === 'heaven' ? 'VIEW HELL SIDE' : 'VIEW HEAVEN SIDE';
            } else {
                // Fate was sealed by the quiz — no peeking at the road not taken.
                switchBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
            goToSection('sec-event');
        }

        function switchTheme() {
            chosenDestination = chosenDestination === 'heaven' ? 'hell' : 'heaven';
            applyTheme(chosenDestination);
            const switchBtn = document.getElementById('theme-switch-btn');
            switchBtn.innerText = chosenDestination === 'heaven' ? 'VIEW HELL SIDE' : 'VIEW HEAVEN SIDE';
        }

        function startCountdown() {
            const targetDate = new Date('October 4, 2026 16:00:00').getTime();
            const timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                const distance = targetDate - new Date().getTime();
                if (distance < 0) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    document.getElementById('countdown-timer').innerHTML = '<div style="font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-gold); padding: 1rem;">THE NIGHT HAS BEGUN.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                const days = Math.floor(distance / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
                const hours = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                const minutes = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                const seconds = Math.floor((distance % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                document.getElementById('cd-days').innerText = String(days).padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById('cd-hours').innerText = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById('cd-minutes').innerText = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0');
                document.getElementById('cd-seconds').innerText = String(seconds).padStart(2, '0');
            }, 1000);
        }

        function openQrModal() { document.getElementById('qr-modal').classList.add('active'); }
        function closeQrModal() { document.getElementById('qr-modal').classList.remove('active'); }

        function handleRsvp(choice) {
            rsvpChoice = choice;
            document.getElementById('rsvp-options').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('rsvp-heading').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('rsvp-sub').style.display = 'none';

            const respContainer = document.getElementById('rsvp-response');
            const respTitle = document.getElementById('rsvp-resp-title');
            const respDesc = document.getElementById('rsvp-resp-desc');
            const changeWrap = document.getElementById('rsvp-change-wrap');
            const nextBtn = document.getElementById('rsvp-next-btn');

            respContainer.style.display = 'block';

            if (choice === 'yes') {
                respTitle.innerText = "ЗӨВ СОНГОЛТ ХИЙЛЭЭ";
                respDesc.innerText = "WE'LL SEE YOU ON THE OTHER SIDE.";
                changeWrap.style.display = 'none';
                nextBtn.innerText = 'Төлбөр рүү шилжих';
            } else {
                respTitle.innerText = "ХАРАМСАЛТАЙ...";
                respDesc.innerText = "Шийдвэрээ өөрчлөхөд одоо ч оройтоогүй .";
                changeWrap.style.display = 'block';
                nextBtn.innerText = 'FINAL DESTINY';
            }
        }

        function afterRsvp() {
            if (rsvpChoice === 'yes') {
                goToSection('sec-payment');
            } else {
                goToSection('sec-outro');
            }
        }

        function resetRsvp() {
            document.getElementById('rsvp-response').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('rsvp-options').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('rsvp-heading').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('rsvp-sub').style.display = 'block';
        }

        function initParticles() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('particle-canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            let height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            });

            const particles = [];
            const particleCount = 65;
            for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
                particles.push({
                    x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height,
                    radius: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
                    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4, vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4 - 0.2,
                    alpha: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.1
                });
            }

            function render() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
                    if (p.x < 0) p.x = width; if (p.x > width) p.x = 0;
                    if (p.y < 0) p.y = height; if (p.y > height) p.y = 0;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    if (particleTheme === 'heaven') ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${p.alpha})`;
                    else if (particleTheme === 'hell') ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 60, 20, ${p.alpha})`;
                    else ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 180, 220, ${p.alpha * 0.6})`;
                    ctx.fill();
                });
                requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }
            render();
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
